title: Septic Service Equipment Inspection Report Form
subtitle: Control site assessment, safe access, inspection, pumping, maintenance, transport, and handoff through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete septic service equipment inspection report for tanks, baffles, pumps, controls, distribution components, and drainfield observations. It connects system records, approved scope, and disposal authority to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified septic-service technician must inspect tanks, baffles, pumps, controls, distribution components, and drainfield observations against stated criteria and issue a traceable condition, restriction, corrective-action, or release decision.

sections.title: Septic Service inspection scope, criteria, and readiness
sections.guidance: Do not infer whole-asset or whole-site condition from a limited, inaccessible, or unqualified inspection.

blocks.label: Inspection access and control readiness
items: Property, system, access, buried-utility, and component locations confirmed
Tank, cover, riser, and surrounding ground assessed before opening
No person enters a tank or confined space under this general service record
People, children, pets, vehicles, and ignition sources excluded from the work zone
Sewage exposure PPE, hygiene, decontamination, and spill controls available
Hose, vacuum, truck, pump, valve, cap, and containment condition checked
Ventilation and atmospheric warning signs receive a stop-work response
Liquid, sludge, scum, effluent, and pumped volume observations traceable
Transport vehicle, manifest, receiving facility, and disposal route assigned
Covers, alarms, power, grade, and site security restored before release

sections.title: Septic Service equipment inspection report closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This septic service equipment inspection report is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when tank access, collapse, confined-space, toxic or flammable atmosphere, sewage exposure, buried utility, pumping, transport, disposal, or system condition is uncertain. A septic, wastewater, or safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
